verdict.rationale: Galileo's own docs show metrics running against live logged traffic. Logging produces a real-time stream, guides enable metrics like instruction_adherence to monitor the model, and alerts fire on metrics such as Correctness and Context Adherence over log time windows. The marketing site also claims Luna-distilled evals monitor 100% of traffic. However, the evidence never documents how evaluators are configured to run automatically on every production log, and much of the support is marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on attaching evaluators to production log streams (sampling, scope, latency), documentation of continuous online evaluation beyond marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.
Distill your optimized evals into Luna models that monitor 100% of your traffic at 96% lower cost.
We'll enable the `instruction_adherence` metric to monitor the model's adherence to the prompt.
Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour
